mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital and encourages risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 8.0% and decline in industrial production below 97.0 signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0 and INDPRO < 97.0 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by housing starts above 750,000 units), strong retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) signal robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 750.0 and RSAFS > 400000 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 98.0 (indicating robust manufacturing activity) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 98.0 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates robust household demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS increasing by more than 100,000 jobs in the past month) signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A recent decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS falling below 0.20% in the past month) signals imminent monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.20% (based on 10-year rolling window).
